## All-time Hodge Trophy leaders

This list ranks Division I Hodge Trophy winners by trophy count, then career wins. It is a leaderboard of Hodge winners, not a claim that these are the ten most winning wrestlers regardless of award.

| Rank | Wrestler | Hodge trophies (years) | Bonus win rate % | Career record (W-L) | Avg. match time |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | [Cael Sanderson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cael_Sanderson) | 3 (2000–02) | [83.0%](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cael_Sanderson#Collegiate_record) | 159–0 | N/A |
| 2 | [Ben Askren](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ben_Askren) | 2 (2006–07) | N/A | 153–8 | N/A |
| 3 | [David Taylor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Taylor_(wrestler)) | 2 (2012, 2014) | [90.3%](https://www.win-magazine.com/2014/04/01/david-taylor-wins-2014-dan-hodge-trophy/) | 134–3 | N/A |
| 4 | [Zain Retherford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zain_Retherford) | 2 (2017–18) | [75.4%](https://gopsusports.com/sports/wrestling/roster/season/2017-18/player/zain-retherford) | 126–3 | N/A |
| 5 | [Spencer Lee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spencer_Lee_(wrestler)) | 2 (2020–21) | [85.7%](https://hawkeyesports.com/sports/wrestling/roster/season/2022-23/player/spencer-lee) | 98–6 | N/A |
| 6 | [Gable Steveson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gable_Steveson) | 2 (2021–22) | [73.8%](https://gophersports.com/sports/wrestling/roster/gable-steveson/22871) | N/A | N/A |
| 7 | [Kyle Dake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyle_Dake) | 1 (2013) | [60.6%](https://cornellbigred.com/sports/wrestling/roster/kyle-dake/33432) | 137–4 | N/A |
| 8 | [Alex Dieringer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alex_Dieringer) | 1 (2016) | [72.9%](https://okstate.com/sports/wrestling/roster/alex-dieringer/3042) | 133–4 | N/A |
| 9 | [Jordan Burroughs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jordan_Burroughs) | 1 (2011) | N/A | 128–20 | N/A |
| 10 | [Mason Parris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mason_Parris) | 1 (2023) | [66.1%](https://mgoblue.com/sports/wrestling/roster/mason-parris/23669) | 124–18 | N/A |

The [WIN Magazine Hodge Trophy archive](https://www.win-magazine.com/win-awards/hodge-trophy/) is the source for award winners and years. Bonus win rate % shows career bonus-point wins (falls, technical falls, and major decisions) divided by career wins from official school biographies, WIN Magazine, and match archives; N/A means a complete four-year bonus breakdown was not verified in the sources consulted. Average match time was not available from a consistent, verifiable source, so it is N/A throughout. Career records are linked to wrestler biographies; Steveson's career total was not verified and is left as N/A.
